user_story: As a user, I want to update the priority of an existing task so that I can reprioritize my work.

positive.title: Successfully update task priority to High
steps: Change the priority from Medium to High
positive.expected_result: The task priority is updated to High in the tasks list.

positive.title: Successfully update task priority to Low
steps: Change the priority from High to Low
positive.expected_result: The task priority is updated to Low in the tasks list.

positive.title: Successfully update task priority to Medium
steps: Change the priority from Low to Medium
positive.expected_result: The task priority is updated to Medium in the tasks list.

negative.title: Attempt to update task priority with invalid value
steps: Change the priority to an invalid value (e.g., 'Urgent')
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the priority value is invalid.

negative.title: Attempt to update priority without selecting a task
steps: Click on 'Update Priority' without selecting any task
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that no task is selected.

edge.title: Update task priority when no tasks exist
steps: Navigate to the tasks list where no tasks are present
Attempt to update priority of a non-existing task
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that no tasks are available to update.

edge.title: Update priority rapidly multiple times
steps: Rapidly change the priority multiple times in quick succession
edge.expected_result: The task priority is updated successfully to the last selected value without errors.
